meta.subject: cache multi-porting fix - ensure per-bank uniform rw

en.summary: Fixes cache bank coalescing so requests sharing a bank must agree on read/write direction before they are treated as a uniform bank transaction.
why_it_counts: The patch changes bank-selection and merge eligibility in cache RTL.
It prevents incompatible read and write operations from being coalesced together.
The commit message explicitly describes a per-bank uniform-rw bug.
evidence: VX_core_req_bank_sel adds per_bank_rw_r alongside per-bank line tracking.
core_req_line_match now requires both same line address and same core_req_rw value.
The cache-define macros used for bank and line extraction are updated in the same fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A multi-ported cache bank selector may coalesce multiple same-bank requests into one bank transaction, but that is only safe when the requests are semantically compatible. If the merge rule checks only bank and line address while ignoring read-versus-write direction, a read and a write can be treated as one uniform operation and the bank sees an invalid combined access pattern.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple same-cycle requests target the same bank and line, but at least one is a read and another is a write.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow same-bank requests to coalesce based only on address match, ignoring whether the operations are reads or writes.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop operation-kind term from merge predicate
portability_notes: This maps to bank selectors, LSU coalescers, and cache request grouping logic.
The important compatibility test is semantic access type, not just physical address.
If your DUT uses opcodes instead of a single rw bit, mutate the equivalent read/write-class check.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that decides whether multiple requests can share one bank access or one port slot.
Identify the predicate that checks same-bank and same-line compatibility.
Remove the read/write-direction equality requirement so address match alone is sufficient.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix records per-bank rw state and adds core_req_rw equality to core_req_line_match so only uniform access types coalesce.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_core_req_bank_sel, core_req_line_match changed from an address-only comparison to an address-and-rw comparison using per_bank_rw_r.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A read and a write aimed at the same bank can be merged incorrectly, causing lost operations, wrong bank behavior, or misclassified accesses.
evidence_for_injection: The only added state in the selector is per_bank_rw_r, which exists solely to constrain merge eligibility.
The commit subject explicitly states the intended invariant: per-bank uniform rw.
The updated address-selection macros support the same bank-selection path.
notes: The most direct reinjection is to remove only the rw equality test and leave the rest of the selector intact.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache bank 合并条件：共享同一 bank 的请求在被视为统一 bank 事务之前，必须先保证读写方向一致。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 cache RTL 中的 bank 选择与合并资格判定。
它阻止了语义不兼容的读写操作被错误地合并在一起。
提交标题明确描述了 per-bank uniform rw 缺陷。
evidence: VX_core_req_bank_sel 在每个 bank 的 line 跟踪之外新增了 per_bank_rw_r。
core_req_line_match 现在同时要求 line 地址一致且 core_req_rw 一致。
同一修复还更新了用于提取 bank/line 的 cache-define 宏。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 多端口 cache 的 bank selector 可能会把同一个 bank 上的多个请求合并为一次 bank 事务，但只有当这些请求在语义上兼容时才安全。如果合并规则只检查 bank 和 line 地址，而忽略读写方向，那么一次读和一次写就可能被当成统一操作处理，导致 bank 看到无效的混合访问模式。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 同 bank 请求的合并资格判定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 同一周期内多个请求命中同一 bank 和同一 line，但其中既有读也有写。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 允许同一 bank 的请求只按地址匹配进行合并，而忽略读写类型是否一致。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从合并谓词中删除访问类型判断项
portability_notes: 可映射到 bank selector、LSU coalescer 或 cache 请求分组逻辑。
关键兼容性约束是访问语义类型，而不仅仅是物理地址。
如果 DUT 用 opcode 而不是单个 rw 位，应修改等价的读写类别检查。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到决定多个请求是否可共享一次 bank 访问或一个端口槽位的逻辑。
识别同时检查 same-bank 和 same-line 的兼容性谓词。
删除读写方向一致性的要求，使地址匹配本身就足以触发合并。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_core_req_bank_sel 中的 per-bank 请求匹配
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为每个 bank 记录 rw 状态，并把 core_req_rw 相等条件加入 core_req_line_match，确保只有统一访问类型才会合并。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_core_req_bank_sel 中，core_req_line_match 从“只比较地址”变成了“地址和 rw 都比较”，其中新增状态是 per_bank_rw_r。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 指向同一 bank 的读和写会被错误合并，造成操作丢失、bank 行为错误或访问类型误判。
evidence_for_injection: selector 中唯一新增的状态就是 per_bank_rw_r，它只服务于合并资格约束。
提交标题直接给出了目标不变量：per-bank uniform rw。
更新后的地址提取宏服务于同一条 bank 选择路径。
notes: 最直接的回注方式是只删除 rw 相等判断，而保留 selector 的其他逻辑不变。
